anna_marketing: Quick check — we're planning the small experiment for the pricing page: add 'commitment badges' for annual/committed tiers + a usage slider calc variant. Want to ship FAQ copy tweak with it. timeline this week?

mike_growth: love it. can we A/B test slider vs static examples? :eyes:

jyoti_product: yes. product note: slider should feed into shown estimated monthly cost and show committed discount badge. Also need to surface Dedicated vs Hosted differences in FAQ.

lina_design: working on 3 badge options in figma: 'Save 20%', 'Predictable cost', 'Reserved capacity'. I'll drop links.

lina_design: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/pricing-badges (mock)

sam_engineering: FYI front-end can support slider + badges. need API from pricing-service for unit-cost / region parity. ETA 48 hours if no blockers.

jyoti_product: callout — we should avoid using 'committed' in public copy; customers confuse with Dedicated. Proposal: use 'Annual commitment' and in FAQ show mapping to Dedicated/reserved.

mike_growth: agreed. variant names for experiment: control, slider-badges, slider-badges+FAQ. call it 'slider-badge-expt'.

anna_marketing: can ops help with analytics? want events: pricing_page_view, slider_input, cta_click, faq_expand

ops-bot: analytics events scaffolded in segment-dev: pricing_page_view, pricing_slider_change, pricing_cta_click, faq_toggle

sam_engineering: will add event hooks. A/B platform requires variant keys by EOD.

lina_design: microcopy for FAQ drafted: 'What is an annual commitment? — A discounted plan for customers who prepay 12 months. This unlocks reservation benefits but doesn't change hosted vs dedicated.' Will post in doc.

mike_growth: can we include small sentence about refund policy? reduces support tickets.

jyoti_product: yes — add: 'Refunds prorated; see T&Cs' — but legal to sign off.

anna_marketing: next steps: sam to add event hooks, lina to upload assets, jyoti to update FAQ doc, mike to set experiment configs. check-in tomorrow 10am. :white_check_mark:

mike_growth: +1

sam_engineering: +1
